name: app-onboarding-screens-discount-outline-icons-lilac
title: Lilac onboarding screens with line-icon discount illustrations
whatItIs: Four phone onboarding screens on a lilac background, each pairing a bold outline icon (calendar, list, bag, chat) with a small illustrated character and a 'More Info' button.
whatItMeans: Consistent bold-line iconography plus one recurring character keeps each onboarding step visually tied together while each screen still communicates a distinct benefit.
techniques: pair a big centered line icon with a small supporting character illustration per screen
hold one flat background color across the whole onboarding flow for cohesion
repeat an identical CTA button style/position across screens to build a predictable rhythm

vocabulary.definition: the sequence of introductory screens shown to a first-time app user to explain key features
